3284-3490-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

728-6972-7236.description:

When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.

1703-2511-4984.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2292-2728-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2292-2728-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2292-2728-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

360-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

670-1619-5887-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6145.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Passageway Seer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

851-4682-5140-6753.description:

Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.

851-4682-5140-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-5448-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

250-779-1479-5413-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
